decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records simple bowl removal for cleaning and extends this Requirement to the retail food-service context.
The source discusses sanitation, removable parts, liquid isolation, and service access but does not change the existing splash-control behavior or scope.
The source's bowl-removal clause affects the separate quick-swap bowl Requirement and does not change bowl capacity, depth, or geometry.
A same-message MODIFY already records sanitation access, liquid-trap prevention, and food-service scope for the dispensing path.
Simple whisk removal for cleaning changes removability scope, not mixing quality, foam production, whisk geometry, or positioning.
The sanitation and maintenance decision does not alter dispensing actuation, valve selection, flow behavior, or operator controls.
A same-message MODIFY already applies the food-service context to the requirement that liquids remain separated from electrical components.
A same-message MODIFY already extends component maintenance and replacement access to the food-service context.
A same-message INTRODUCE already captures the food-safe material standard and its food-contact and food-service scope.
Maintenance access for possible component replacement does not change motor durability or maximum-speed duty constraints.
The source does not change motor speed range, maximum RPM, independent control, or intended speed modes.
The retail food-service and sanitation considerations do not change the device's colors or visual styling.
